original.selection_notes: Baseline unmodified source. Lower score expected on all six eval cases due to missing evidence reading order, ambiguous engineer handoff trigger, underspecified validation, and absent loop-exit rule.

student.selection_notes: Optimized candidate from manual_followup @trainer inference. Addresses all six weaknesses identified in engineer-prompt/review.md. Predicted to score highest on eval cases 1-6.

adversary.selection_notes: Adversary exploit: engineer/teacher handoff over-triggering and open-ended evidence reading. Not credible enough to override student candidate. Extra judge steering added to block handoff-trigger exploitation.

selection_reason: Student candidate directly addresses all six weaknesses in the engineering review without introducing the adversary's over-triggering or scope expansion. Adversary exploit was assessed as not credible. Original baseline had too many protocol gaps to be competitive.
